question: Hindustan Republcan Association took to socialist ideas, under whose leadership, in 1928?
solution:
correct answer is__** ​Chandra Sekhar Azad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hindustan Republican Association (HRA) embraced socialist ideas under the** leadership of Chandrashekhar Azad in 1928.**
 
• **Chandrashekhar Azad** was a** prominent revolutionary **and freedom fighter in India during the struggle for independence.
 
• The HRA later evolved into the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) .
 
• It reflect its commitment to **socialist principles and continued its efforts against British colonial rule.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• 
 HSRA was **founded by Ram Prasad Bismil **and other important figures associated with HSRA are:

 
 
• 
 **Chandrasekhar Azad, Ashfaqulla Khan, Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev Thapar and Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee.**
 
 
 
 
• 
 • The **main reason **for the party’s formation was Mahatma Gandhi’s** calling off the non-cooperation movement in 1922** because of the Chauri Chaura incident.
 
 
• 
 The revolutionary activities of HSRA were:

 
 
• 
 **Conducting robberies** and raids in an attempt to raise funds to acquire arms and ammunition.
 
 
• 
 **Kakori Conspiracy**.
 
 
• 
 The **killing of John Saunders** to exact revenge.
 
 
• 
 C**entral Assembly Bombing Case**.
